scope: Named primary members from public class documentation. Subset never means full class parity. Remaining exported classes have no member-level certification.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.limits: CommonJS default class only; no DOM, Node, external npm modules, CSS, marketplace or external-settings events. Lifecycle completion is async in Engine.

classes.name: Component
classes.limits: Await load/unload. Child load/unload callbacks are not guaranteed synchronous.

classes.name: Events
classes.limits: Standalone emitter; host-provided event coverage separately bounded.

classes.name: Vault
classes.limits: Text formats only. DataWriteOptions rejected. configDir .crafactory. Only modify event, others rejected. Snapshot stats; no multi-process locks/fsync certification. Vault.rename/trash support non-root TFile and TFolder subtrees; getResourcePath returns the storage asset data URL.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.limits: One active editor and minimal MarkdownView; existing file navigation, no heading jump, newLeaf or openState. Only file-open event, snapshot timing differs from reference focus/leaf behavior.

classes.name: Editor
classes.limits: One UTF-16 selection; Worker snapshot and async serialized expected-text host mutations. Source mode full-file offsets; live selections inside hidden properties rejected.

classes.name: TAbstractFile
classes.limits: Identity retained at unchanged paths; file/folder rename keeps the moved object subtree identity at its new paths.

classes.name: TFile
classes.limits: Filesystem snapshot ctime/mtime/size, not full reference stat semantics.

classes.name: MetadataCache
classes.limits: app.metadataCache resolver only; its class export and all host cache events rejected. Exact cache positions/shapes and complete link resolution unfinished.

classes.name: Notice
classes.limits: String message to shared toast; duration, multiple notices and DOM are not reference-equivalent. DocumentFragment rejected.

classes.name: MarkdownView
classes.limits: Minimal command context. Other inherited members not individually behavior-audited; no DOM view integration.
